environment.description: Celery worker deployed in ECS Fargate task within VPC subnet subnet-0f7a2e (10.0.64.0/20). Subnet route table rtb-3c8d9f has local route 10.0.0.0/16 -> local and no additional routes. No internet gateway, no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoint for logs or monitoring services attached. Task ENI receives IP from subnet CIDR only. Security group sg-worker-7f2a permits inbound from sg-redis-4b1c on port 6379 and denies all other traffic in both directions. VPC Flow Logs confirm zero packets to destinations outside 10.0.0.0/16 CIDR in past 90 days.

config.network: private subnet 10.0.64.0/20, route table rtb-3c8d9f with ONLY local route
config.vpc_endpoints: com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 (gateway, for ECR image layers only), no logs/monitoring endpoints
config.security_group: sg-worker-7f2a: inbound TCP/6379 from sg-redis-4b1c, outbound DENY ALL except TCP/6379 to sg-redis-4b1c
config.dns_resolution: VPC DNS resolver only, no Route53 outbound resolver endpoints
